about: Solomon's lament continues: the kings and priests loved worldly things more than God's word, and God, who swore by himself to keep the world in order while Zion stayed on earth, has taken the Ark from them and given it to a people who obey him. The spirit of prophecy answers him: it was God's will, and the Ark was given to Solomon's own firstborn son, in keeping with the oath to David. Solomon is comforted and submits to God's will, and an angel appears and promises him God's love if he keeps the commandments. Several words in the long lists are uncertain.

sentences.l: Kingdom-too not-it-profits without purity, and-judgment too not-it-profits without uprightness, and-wealth-too not-it-profits without fear-of God;
sentences.i: A kingdom too is of no use without purity, judgment too is of no use without uprightness, and wealth too is of no use without the fear of God;
sentences.n: Solomon's lament now turns into a moral accusation. The frame is ኢይበቊዕ ዘእንበለ 'it does not profit without' (በቊዐ 'to avail, be of use'; ዘእንበለ 'without'), repeated three times, each subject carrying the particle -ኒ 'too, also' (መንግሥትኒ, ብዕልኒ). The middle one is printed ወፍትሕ ፡ ኒ with a space; I read it as ወፍትሕኒ 'and judgment too' (ፍትሕ 'judgment'). ንጽሕ 'purity', ርትዕ 'uprightness'. ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር 'fear-of God' is a construct chain (ፍርሀት, construct ፍርሀተ). ወ- 'and' joins the clauses.

sentences.l: Priests-too loved talk-of chatter(?) more-than word-of books, and-they-loved voice-of lyre more-than voice-of psalm, and-they-loved work-of world more-than prayer, and-they-loved ?-of world(?) more-than word-of divinity, and-they-loved laughter and-fornication more-than weeping-of life(?), and-they-loved food passing more-than fasting for-God, and-they-loved drink and-drunkenness more-than offering for-God, and-they-loved idleness more-than petition, and-they-loved goods more-than alms, and-they-loved sleep more-than praise, and-they-loved drowsiness(?) more-than vigil.
sentences.i: The priests too loved idle talk (?) more than the words of the Scriptures; they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm, worldly work more than prayer, worldly pleasure (?) more than the word of divinity, laughter and lewdness more than weeping over life (?), passing food more than fasting for God, drink and drunkenness more than offering sacrifice to God, idleness more than petition, possessions more than almsgiving, sleep more than praise, and drowsiness (?) more than the vigil.
sentences.n: One catalogue built on a single pattern, አፍቀረ X እም Y 'he loved X more than Y' (እም- 'from, than' makes the comparison; ወአፍቀሩ 'and they loved', 3rd plural perfect). Many nouns stand in the construct state before a genitive: ነገረ መጻሕፍት 'word-of books (the Scriptures)', ቃለ መሰንቆ 'voice-of the lyre' (the masenqo), ቃለ መዝሙር 'voice-of psalm', ግብረ ዓለም 'work-of the world', ቃለ መለኮት 'word-of divinity', ብካየ ሕይወት 'weeping-of life'. There is no ፤ to cut at, so the unit stays long (about 48 words). Uncertain (?): ዘውዕ (I take it as 'idle talk', from the root of መስተዛውዓን in the next unit); ቅሥተ ዓለም (ቅሥት unknown to me, 'worldly pleasure' is a guess); ብካየ ሕይወት (could be 'weeping for life'); ነዛህላለ (probably 'drowsiness', set against ንቃህ 'vigil, wakefulness'). ሰሐቀ 'laughter' (ሰ is written for ሠ, so ሥሕቅ; (?)), ዝሙተ 'fornication' (here perhaps 'lewdness'); ንዋየ 'goods' vs ምጽወት 'alms'. Dillmann's lexicon was not available.

sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! We kings have neglected the commandment of God, and we have loved the talk of chatterers more than the voice of the priests. We want to gaze at the face of our women rather than seek the face of God in repentance; we have loved looking at our little ones more than hearing the word of God, taking comfort in the sardius stone more than setting judgment straight for the orphan, looking at our own splendor more than hearing the word of God, the talk of (?) more than the voice of the wise, and the talk of fools more than hearing the word of the prophets.
sentences.n: The refrain አሌለነ 'woe to us' (አሌ 'woe' + ለነ 'to us', as in part 1) opens the confession; now the speakers are the kings (ነገሥትኒ 'we kings too'). Same እም- comparison, now with 1st plural verbs (ወአፍቀርነ 'and we loved', -ነ 'we'). ተሀከይነ 'we were negligent' (ተሀከየ 'be slack'; same root as ሀኬተ 'idleness' in the last unit) takes እምነ 'from'. ካህናትወገጸ is printed as one word; I read ካህናት ወገጸ 'priests; and the face-of', so the sentence continues 'and the face of our women we desire to see'. ንፈቅድ ነጽሮ 'we desire to see' (verb + infinitive); ገጸ 'face-of' (construct of ገጽ); አንስቲያነ 'our women'. ተናዝዞ 'taking comfort' (infinitive of ተናዘዘ 'be comforted'; the sense is uncertain (?)) with እብነ ሰርድዮን 'stone-of sardius', a precious stone (Exodus 28:17), i.e. jewellery. አርትዖ ፍትሕ ለእጓለ ማውታ 'making judgment straight for the orphan' (እጓለ ማውታ 'offspring-of the dead' = orphan). መስተዛውዓን 'chatterers' (a participial form, reading uncertain (?)). ነገረ በክ: I cannot read በክ (?); it is set against ማእምራን 'those who know, the wise', and the next phrase has ነገረ እቡዳን 'talk-of fools' (plural እቡዳን of አብድ 'fool'). ነቢያት 'prophets'. There is no ፤ to cut at, so the unit stays long (about 51 words).

sentences.i: Woe to us! He gave us glory, and in our folly we cast it off; he made us exceedingly wise, and by our own will we acted more foolishly than the beasts; he gave us wealth, and we impoverished ourselves (?) of almsgiving.
sentences.n: ወሀበነ 'he gave us' (ወሀበ + ነ 'us'); አጥበበነ 'he made us wise' (causative of ጠበበ 'be wise'); ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ወበእበድነ ገደፍነ: በእበድነ 'in our folly' (እበድ 'folly'), ገደፍነ 'we cast off' (the 'it' is left unexpressed). አበድነ 'we were foolish' (አበደ 'be mad, foolish'), with እምነ እንስሳ 'more than beasts'. ወአንደይነ ርእስነ እምጽዋት: አንደየ is not a verb I know securely; I take it as a causative of ነደየ 'be poor' (cf. ነዳይ 'poor'), 'we made poor', with ርእስነ 'our head, ourselves' as object, so 'we impoverished ourselves (?) of almsgiving'. እምጽዋት = እም- + ጽዋት, or እም- + ምጽዋት 'alms' with the ም lost (?). sentences.i: And what God hates is: ... idolatry (?), ... divination (?), sorcery (?), ..., ..., ..., the dead (?), theft, injustice, fornication, envy, ..., drinking and drunkenness, false oaths made to their neighbors, and false witness against their neighbors; all this they do, which God hates.
sentences.n: The counterpart list, items joined by ወ-. I give the readable items and mark the rest, since Dillmann was unavailable (?): ተጠይሮ (unknown; perhaps 'disdain'), ወአጣዕዎ (from ጣዖት 'idol': 'idolatry'?), ሐቲተ ማሪት (ሐቲት 'inquiry' + ?), መቃስም ('diviners, divination', from ቀሰመ), ሰገል ('sorcery'?), ጽንጽንያ (?), አቀሪኖ (?), ብትክ (?), ማውታ ('the dead', as in እጓለ ማውታ; out of place in this list, perhaps necromancy (?)), ሐቢል (?). Clear ones: ስርቅ 'theft', ዐመፃ 'injustice', ዝሙት 'fornication', ተቃንኦ 'envy, zeal', ስታይ 'drinking', ስካር 'drunkenness', ማሕላ በሐሰት 'an oath in falsehood', ስምዐ ሐሰት 'witness-of falsehood' (false witness; Exodus 20:16). The last clause is a summary, ዘንተ ኵሎ ይገብሩ ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'this all they do which God hates'. ዘይጸልእሰ: -ሰ 'indeed, as for' marks the contrast with the loved things above. The English is rough where marked (?); the Geʿez is as printed.

sentences.n: ወበእንተ ዝንቱኬ 'and because of this indeed' (በእንተ 'on account of'; ዝንቱ 'this' + -ኬ emphatic). ዘነሥኣ እግዚኣብሔር ለታቦተ ኪዳኑ 'that God took her, the Ark of his covenant' (ዘ- here 'that, the fact that'; ነሥአ 'take'; -ኣ 'her' doubled by ለታቦተ). ታቦተ ኪዳን 'ark-of covenant', as in part 1. ወወሀባ 'and gave her'. እለ ይገብሩ 'who do' (እለ plural relative). ፈቃዶ ወሕጎ ወሥርዐቶ 'his will, his law, his ordinance'. The 'people' who receive the Ark are Ethiopia in the story's reading, but Solomon does not yet say so.

sentences.i: He turned his face from us and made it shine upon them; he turned away (?) from us and loved them, he had mercy on them and destroyed us, because he took the Ark of his covenant from us.
sentences.n: ሜጠ ገጾ 'he turned his face' (the idiom of God's withdrawal), against ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and made his face shine upon them' (cf. the blessing of Numbers 6:25, Psalm 67:1). ኪያነ ... ኪያሆሙ 'us ... them' are the accusative pronouns ኪያ- + ነ/ሆሙ. ተሀየየ 'turned away (?)' as in part 1 (uncertain). አፍቀረ 'loved', መሐረ 'had mercy', አጥፍአ 'destroyed' (አጥፍአ, the same verb as the earlier አጥፋእከ; here the final -ኣ is part of the 3rd masc. form, 'he destroyed'). The closing clause repeats the reason, በእንተ ዘነሥኣ.

sentences.i: For he swore an oath by himself that he would not withhold the winter and the summer, the seedtime and the harvest of fruit, or the work of the sun and the moon, so long as Zion was on earth; that he would not be angry with heaven and earth by flood or by fire, nor destroy man, beast or wild animals; but rather that he would have mercy on the work of his hands and multiply his mercy upon his creature (?);
sentences.n: The oath refers to Genesis 8:21–22 (after the flood, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter will not cease) and Genesis 9:11, and to Hebrews 6:13 (God swearing by himself). መሐለ ማሕላ 'he swore an oath' (verb + cognate accusative); በርእሱ 'by himself' (literally 'by his head'). ከመ ኢይከልእ 'that he not withhold' (ከመ + subjunctive; the same ከመ ኢ- opens each negative clause). ክረምተ 'winter, rainy season', ሐጋየ 'summer' (ሐጋይ), ዘርአ ወማእረረ ፍሬ 'seed(time) and harvest-of fruit' (ዘርአ 'seed' is its own item, the pair ዘርአ ወማእረረ as elsewhere; ፍሬ completes the construct ማእረረ), ተግባረ ፀሐየ ወወርኀ 'work-of sun and moon'. እንዘ ሀለወት ጽዮን ዲበ ምድር 'while Zion was upon the earth': the condition ties the world's order to the Ark's presence (feminine ሀለወት). ኢበአይኅ ወኢበእሳት 'not by flood nor by fire' (አይኅ 'flood'). አላ ዳእሙ 'but rather'. ምሕረቶላዕለ is printed fused; I read ምሕረቶ ላዕለ 'his mercy upon'. ልሕኵቱ: from ልሕከ 'stick, adhere', so something like 'his moulded thing, creature' (?); uncertain.

sentences.i: for God swore to David in truth, and will not repent, that he would set one from the fruit of his body upon his throne forever, in the Ark of his covenant, holy Zion;
sentences.n: The Davidic oath: Psalm 132:11–12 ('The Lord has sworn to David a sure oath from which he will not turn: one of the fruit of your body I will set on your throne') and Psalm 89:3–4, 35–37; 2 Samuel 7:12–16. መሐለ ለዳዊት በጽድቅ 'he swore to David in truth'; ኢይኔስሕ 'he will not repent' (ነስሐ 'repent, change his mind'). ከመ 'that' introduces the content of the oath; እምፍሬ ከርሡ 'from the fruit-of his belly' (construct chain; ከርሥ 'belly, womb'); ያነብር 'he set, he is to set' (3ms subjunctive after ከመ; አነበረ, causative of ነበረ 'sit'). In the story, the 'fruit' is Solomon's line, and the Ark's new home is the place where the oath is kept. በውስተ ታቦተ ኪዳኑ ጽዮን ቅድስት 'in the Ark of his covenant, holy Zion': ጽዮን is in apposition, the Ark and Zion being one.

sentences.n: The oath is read as fulfilled in Christ: the descendant of David sits on the throne of divinity ሕያዋነ ወሙታነ 'the living and the dead' (cf. 2 Timothy 4:1; the creed), and every knee bows and every tongue praises (Philippians 2:10–11, Isaiah 45:23). በሰማያትኒ 'in the heavens too'; ዘይነብር 'he who sits'; መንበረ መለኮት 'throne-of divinity' (construct); በሥጋ 'in flesh'. ይኴንን 'he will judge' (ኰነነ). ይገንዩ ሎቱ 'they will serve him' (ገንየ 'serve, bow'; ሎቱ 'to him'); ይሴብሖ 'it (every tongue) will praise him' (-ሖ = 3rd masc. object suffix); ብርክ 'knee'; ቀላያት 'seas, deeps' and አፍላግ 'rivers' (cf. sentences.n: The prophetic voice now commands: ተናዘዝ 'be comforted' (imperative of ተናዘዘ, as in the next unit), ግባእ 'return' (imperative of ገብአ), ወኢታሕዝን 'and do not grieve' (ኢ- + 2nd masc. imperfect of አሕዘነ 'to grieve'). ቤትከወኢታሕዝን is printed as one word; I read ቤትከ ወኢታሕዝን 'your house, and do not grieve'. ልብከ 'your heart', ፍጹመ 'completely'. በዝንቱ 'in this' (በ- 'in, by').

sentences.n: ተናዘዘ 'he was comforted' (3rd masc. perfect; the sense 'confess' is also possible for this stem, so I say 'comforted' because the context is consolation). ይኩን ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'let his will be (that) of God' (ኮነ 'be', jussive; ለ- of possession). ወአኮ ፈቃደ ሰብእ 'and not the will-of man' (አኮ 'not', a nominal negative). The wording recalls 'not my will but yours' (Luke 22:42).

sentences.i: And again the angel of God appeared to him openly and said to him, 'As for you, you built the house of God, and it will be your boast and your support (?), if you keep his commandments and do not worship other gods; then you will be loved in God's sight like David your father.'
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'; አስተርአዮ 'he appeared to him' (አስተርአየ, the stem for a vision or epiphany; -ዮ = + ሁ 'him'); መልአከ እግዚኣብሔር 'angel-of God'; ገሃደ 'openly, plainly'. ወአንተሰ 'and you, for your part' (-ሰ contrast). ሐነጽከ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'you built the house of God' (the Temple). ትከውነከ ምክሐ ይእቲ 'she will be for you a boast' (-ከ 'to you'; ይእቲ 'she' stresses the subject, probably the house, but it may mean the Ark (?)). ምስማከ is 'support, prop' (ምስማክ), reading uncertain (?). ለእመ ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'if you keep his commandments' (ዐቀበ 'keep'); ወኢያምለከ 'and you do not worship' (አምለከ 'worship'; written for a perfect 2nd masc. with -ከ ending written once, as ተመነነ in part 1; the form is uncertain (?)). ባዕደ አማልክተ 'other gods'. ትትፈቀር በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'you will be loved before God' (a passive imperfect). The condition echoes 1 Kings 9:4–9 (God to Solomon: if you walk as David your father did... but if you turn away and serve other gods) and 2 Samuel 7:14–15. ከመ ዳዊት አቡከ 'like David your father'. The part ends here, at the final ፨ ፨ ፨ of the source text.

glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትትፈቀር: ተፈቀረ — she is loved (3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈቀረ; ጥበብ is fem.) · 2ms 'you will be loved' (ትትፈቀር በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር, said to Solomon)
glossary.ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
glossary.ኀላፊተ: ኀላፊ — passing, transient (adjective, fem. ኀላፊት, accusative); 'what passes' used as a noun
glossary.ነዛህላለ: ነዛህላል — drowsiness, dozing (?) (noun, accusative; quadriliteral root uncertain, set against ንቃህ 'vigil')
glossary.ነገሥትኒ: ንጉሥ — kings too (plural ነገሥት + enclitic -ኒ 'too, also')
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
glossary.ነጽሮ: ነጸረ — looking, to look (verbal noun/infinitive ነጽሮ of ነጸረ)
glossary.ኒ: ኒ — too, also (enclitic particle -ኒ, printed here as a separate word after ወፍትሕ)
glossary.ንዋመ: ንዋም — sleep (noun, accusative; cognate object 'slept a sleep')
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — we wish, desire (1cp imperfect, G)
glossary.አሌለነ: አሌ — woe to us (interjection አሌ + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አርኰስና: አርኰሰ — we defiled her (causative 1cp perfect + -ኣ '3fs her', ነ + ኣ fused to -ና; the object doubled by ለሕይወትነ; ረኰሰ 'to be unclean')
glossary.አስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — it appeared to him (3ms perfect + -ዮ 'to him')
glossary.አበድነ: አበደ — we acted foolishly, were foolish (1cp perfect, G; ʾ-b-d)
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አንስቲያነ: ብእሲት — our women (noun, plural አንስት, stem አንስቲያ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አደፈ: አደፍ — filth, dirt (noun, accusative predicate after ዘይከውን; lemma form uncertain) (?)
glossary.አጥበበነ: አጥበበ — he made us wise (3ms perfect, causative of ጠበበ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አፍራሲነ: ፈረስ — our horses (noun, plural አፍራስ, stem አፍራሲ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አፍቀሩ: አፍቀረ — they loved (3mp perfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ኢበአይኅ: አይኅ — not by flood (ኢ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ኢያዐርፍ: አዐረፈ — he does not cease, does not rest (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative; ብካየ 'weeping' and ወአንብዐ 'tears' are its objects)
glossary.ኢያጠፍእ: አጥፍአ — that he not destroy (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative)
glossary.ኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — it is of no use, does not avail (ኢ- negation + 3ms imperfect ይበቊዕ, G)
glossary.ኢይትመዐዕ: ተምዕዐ — that he not be angry (ኢ- + 3ms jussive ይትመዐዕ, Gt stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ)
glossary.ኢይከልእ: ከልአ — that he not withhold (ኢ- + 3ms jussive ይከልእ, G)
glossary.ኢገበርነ: ገብረ — we did not do (negative ኢ- + 1cp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.እመብልዐ: መብልዕ — than food, compared with the food of (እም- + noun, construct 'food of')
glossary.እምሠዊዕ: ሠዊዕ — than sacrificing, offering (እም- 'than' + noun, verbal noun 'sacrifice, offering')
glossary.እምሰሚዐ: ሰምዐ — than hearing (እም- 'than' + infinitive ሰሚዐ, G)
glossary.እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct) · 'than the voice of, more than' in comparison (ወአፍቀሩ ቃለ መሰንቆ እምቃለ መዝሙር 'they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm')
glossary.እምብካየ: ብካይ — than weeping of (እም- 'than' + noun, construct 'weeping of')
glossary.እምኀሢሠ: ኀሠሠ — than seeking (እም- 'than' + infinitive ኀሢሠ, G)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — from the kings of (እም- + plural construct 'kings of') · 'above, higher than the kings of' (ልዑለ እምነገሥተ ምድር 'high above the kings of earth')
glossary.እምነገረ: ነገር — than the word of, from the word of (እም- 'than' + noun, construct 'word of')
glossary.እምአርትዖ: አርትዐ — than setting right, making straight (እም- 'than' + infinitive አርትዖ, causative of ርትዐ)
glossary.እምአዕይንቲሁ: ዐይን — from his eyes (እም- + plural አዕይንት, stem አዕይንቲ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምጸዊም: ጸዊም — than fasting (እም- 'than' + noun, verbal noun of ጾመ 'to fast')
glossary.እምጽዋት: ምጽዋት — than/from almsgiving (እም- + noun; the ም- of ምጽዋት lost after እም-, or ጽዋት) (?)
glossary.እምፍሬ: ፍሬ — from the fruit of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከርሡ: ከርሥ — his belly, his body (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ካህናትወገጸ: ካህን — priests (plural ካህናት) run together with ወገጸ 'and the face of' (ወ- + ገጽ construct), two words printed as one
glossary.ክረምተ: ክረምት — winter, rainy season (noun, f.; accusative/construct form)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀበነ: ወሀበ — he gave us (3ms perfect, G, w-h-b + -ነ '1cp us'; the ወ is a root letter)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወሐቲተ: ሐቲት — and inquiry (?) (ወ- + noun, construct before ማሪት) (?)
glossary.ወሐጋየ: ሐጋይ — and summer (ወ- 'and' + noun; accusative form in -a)
glossary.ወሕጎ: ሕግ — and his law (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወመቃስም: መቅሰም — and divination, diviners (?) (ወ- + noun, plural መቃስም; cf. ቀሰመ 'to divine') (?)
glossary.ወመንበሮሂ: መንበር — and his throne also (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወመኳንንቲነኒ: መኰንን — and our governors too (ወ- + plural መኳንንት, stem መኳንንቲ- + -ነ '1cp our' + enclitic -ኒ 'too')
glossary.ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
glossary.ወማእረረ: ማእረር — and harvest (ወ- 'and' + noun; accusative form)
glossary.ወማውታ: ሙት — and the dead (?) (ወ- + plural ማውታ, cf. እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; here in a list of vices, perhaps necromancy) (?)
glossary.ወምሒረ: ምሒር — and mercy-of, merciful toward (?) (ወ- + noun/participle, construct 'mercy of') (?)
glossary.ወምስማከ: ምስማክ — and support, prop (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወረሳዕነ: ረሰዐ — and we forgot (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G; written ረሳዕነ)
glossary.ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
glossary.ወሰገል: ሰገል — and sorcery, magic (?) (ወ- + noun; also 'magi, sorcerers') (?)
glossary.ወሰጊድ: ሰጊድ — and bowing down, adoration (ወ- 'and' + noun, verbal noun of ሰገደ)
glossary.ወስምዐ: ስምዕ — and witness (ወ- + noun, construct 'witness of')
glossary.ወስርቅ: ስርቅ — and theft (ወ- + noun; also ሥርቅ)
glossary.ወስታይ: ስታይ — and drinking (ወ- + verbal noun of ሰትየ)
glossary.ወቀጠንተ: ቀጠንት — and thinness, fineness (?) (ወ- + noun, construct 'thinness of'; from ቀጠነ 'to be thin') (?)
glossary.ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበአፍላግ: ፈለግ — and in the rivers (ወ- + በ- + plural አፍላግ)
glossary.ወበእበድነ: እበድ — and in our folly (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our'; noun of አበደ 'to be foolish') (?)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — this (demonstrative, masc. sg.; በ- 'by, in', ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወበፈቃድነ: ፈቃድ — and by our will (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወብትክ: ብትክ — ? (?) unknown (ወ- + noun), perhaps 'cutting off' (cf. በተከ)
glossary.ወብዕልኒ: ብዕል — and wealth also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወተቃንኦ: ተቃንኦ — and envy, zeal (ወ- + verbal noun of ተቃንአ)
glossary.ወተግባረ: ተግባር — and the work of (ወ- + noun, construct 'work of')
glossary.ወትከውነከ: ኮነ — and she will be to you (ወ- + 3fs imperfect ትከውን + -ከ '2ms to you')
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወአሕዛብ: ሕዝብ — and nations, peoples (ወ- + plural አሕዛብ)
glossary.ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ወአራዊተ: አርዌ — and beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት, accusative/construct 'beasts of')
glossary.ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative) · transitive 'and he made shine' (ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and he made his face shine upon them')
glossary.ወአብደርነ: አብደረ — and we hastened (?) (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative) (?)
glossary.ወአንብዐ: አንብዕ — and tears (ወ- + noun, plural; accusative)
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንደይነ: አንደየ — and we impoverished (?) (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative, perhaps of ነደየ 'be poor'; cf. ነዳይ; ርእስነ 'ourselves' is the object) (?)
glossary.ወአእተትነልብሰ: አእተተ — and we put away (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative) run together with ልብሰ 'a garment' (ልብስ, accusative), two words printed as one
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአጣዕዎ: አጣዕዎ — and idolatry (?) (ወ- + noun, perhaps related to ጣዖት 'idol'; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአጥፍአ: አጥፍአ — and he destroyed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ጠፍአ)
glossary.ወአፍቀረ: አፍቀረ — and he loved (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአፍቀሩ: አፍቀረ — and they loved (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአፍቀርነ: አፍቀረ — and we loved (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአፍቅሮ: አፍቀረ — and loving (ወ- + infinitive አፍቅሮ, causative)
glossary.ወኢበእሳት: እሳት — and not by fire (ወ- + ኢ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወኢያምለከ: አምለከ — and you do not worship (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms form of አምለከ, 'to worship'; the -ከ ending written once) (?)
glossary.ወኢያእመርና: አእመረ — and we did not know her (ወ- + ኢ- + 1cp perfect, causative, + -ኣ '3fs her', ነ + ኣ fused to -ና; the object doubled by ለነባሪት)
glossary.ወኢያፍቀሩ: አፍቀረ — and they do not love (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, causative, written ኢያፍቀሩ)
glossary.ወኢይኔስሕ: ነስሐ — and he will not repent (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይኔስሕ, G)
glossary.ወእሬስዮ: ረሰየ — and I will make him (ወ- + 1cs imperfect እሬሲ + -ዮ '3ms him')
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወወርኀ: ወርኅ — and moon (ወ- + noun, accusative; also 'month')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘይጸልእሰ: ጸልአ — and what hates, as for what hates (ወ- + ዘ- 'who, what' + 3ms imperfect + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዝሙተ: ዝሙት — and fornication, lewdness (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወየውሀተ: የውሀት — and gentleness (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative; cf. የዋህ 'gentle') (?)
glossary.ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወይሴብሖ: ሴበሐ — and it will praise him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ይሴብሕ + -ሖ '3ms him'; subject ኵሉ ልሳን 'every tongue'; stem ሴበሐ 'to praise')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይገንዩ: ገንየ — and they will serve (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይገንዩ, G)
glossary.ወዮምኒ: ዮም — and today, and now (ወ- + adverb + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወግባእ: ገብአ — and return, go back (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G)
glossary.ወፍትሕ: ፍትሕ — and judgment, justice (ወ- + noun; the -ኒ 'too' follows as a separate word ኒ)
glossary.ዐቀብከ: ዐቀበ — you have kept, guarded (2ms perfect, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘተውህበት: ተውህበ — who was given, which was given (ዘ- + 3fs perfect ተውህበት, Gt passive of ወሀበ)
glossary.ዘነሥኣ: ነሥአ — that he took her (ዘ- 'that, the fact that' + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — which does not profit (ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘውዕ: ዘውዕ — idle talk, chatter (?) (noun; genitive after the construct ነገረ 'talk of'; root of መስተዛውዓን)
glossary.ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ዘይነብር: ነበረ — dwell, sit, remain (3ms imperfect; ዘ- 'who')
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ያብዝኅ: አብዝኀ — that he multiply (3ms jussive, causative of በዝኀ)
glossary.ያነብር: አነበረ — that he set, place (3ms jussive, causative of ነበረ)
glossary.ያጠፍኦሙ: አጥፍአ — he will destroy them (3ms imperfect, causative + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይምሐር: መሐረ — that he have mercy (3ms jussive, G)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብሎ: ብህለ — he says to him (3ms imperfect ይብል, G, defective verb b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይነሥኣ: ነሥአ — he takes her (3ms imperfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
glossary.ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ገደፍነ: ገደፈ — we cast off, threw away (1cp perfect, G)
glossary.ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
glossary.ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative) · predicate accusative 'perfect' (ኩን ፍጹመ 'be perfect')
